LanguageData.AfterTheRain_InspirationReason: [PAWN_nameDef] looked up at the rainbow after the rain, and something stirred.
LanguageData.AfterTheRain_SettingEnabledTip: When off, no new rainbows appear. One already in the sky fades out on its own.
LanguageData.AfterTheRain_SettingMessage: Show a message when a rainbow appears
LanguageData.AfterTheRain_SettingChance: Chance of a rainbow when the rain clears with the sun low: {0}
LanguageData.AfterTheRain_SettingChanceTip: Rolled once each time rain gives way to a clear sky, during the morning or afternoon window (not at midday, not at night).
LanguageData.AfterTheRain_SettingInspiration: Inspiration chance for each colonist who sees it: {0}
LanguageData.AfterTheRain_SettingInspirationTip: At most one colonist is inspired per rainbow. A colonist who is already inspired, or has no inspiration available, is skipped.
